bill.constitutionalAuthorityStatementText:
[Congressional Record Volume 171, Number 122 (Wednesday, July 16, 2025)]
[House]
From the Congressional Record Online through the Government Publishing Office [www.gpo.gov]
By Ms. JAYAPAL:
H.R. 4457.
Congress has the power to enact this legislation pursuant
to the following:
This bill is enacted pursuant to the power granted to
Congress under Article I of the United States Constitution
and its subsequent amendments, and further clarified and
interpreted by the Supreme Court of the United States.
[Page H3368]

latestAction.text: Referred to the Committee on Financial Services, and in addition to the Committees on House Administration, the Judiciary, Education and Workforce, and Ways and Means, for a period to be subsequently determined by the Speaker, in each case for consideration of such provisions as fall within the jurisdiction of the committee concerned.
